book.name: MARCOS
book.title: Marcos' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Tyaapa ejke ruku
Jesús, manen cha' waku wakudinu yasha mavimi, tsenñu junu ma ruku mandyaapa yujka dedeelaa pumi.
Tsenñu mantsala naati' Jesúsnu kuipa pun tsandyamu chachilla dus keetanala, tsejtaa saaduma lekanu malunuren juntsa rukunu ura' manguenmalaya kuipa faawaanu detya' mitya.
Tsenñu Jesús, mandyaapa yujka dedeelaa rukunu: Aanu kejtala kujpa' uidide, timi.

Tsejtu veelanu entsandi pake'meemi: ¿Saaduma lekanu malunu tyee keñaa uranu jun? ¿Uraaya kenuu jun? Tsa jutyu'ba, ¿urajtu juuya kenuu jun? ¿Chachillanu livee kenuuya jun? Tsa jutyu'ba, ¿peyawaakenuuya jun? timi. Tsandiñuren muba yanu depakai'ñu,

Jesús ya' keetala uinamu chachillanu ajaatya' keemi, tsejturen mika pensandyami, yala' tenbukashaya firu' deju' aseetanguenu detyatyuñu' mitya. Tsejtu juntsa dii rukunu entsandimi: Ñu' tyaapa usakide, timi. Tsandiñu juntsa ruku ya' tyaapa uskenmalan tsaa narai mandimi.
Tsanguiñu keena' fariseola demalu' miitu, Herodes rei juñuba uraa tyamu chachillabaa debuudi', Jesúsnu tyee kitaa tu'kaakeechunga ti' paviikila.
Pure' chachillaJesús' bendaa jila.
Jesús ya' disipululaba Galilea pusu pi keesha jila, tsenñu chachilla pure' bendaa jiila, naa Galileasha chulla bain, naa Judeasha chulla bain,

naa Jerusalén' chulla bain, naa Idumea' chulla bain, naa Jordán pi bejkusha chulla bain, naa Tiro pebulu kelutala chulla bain, tsenmin Sidón pebulu kelutala chulla bain, Jesús tyee tsamantsaa kiikeñuba demijatu pure' jiila.
Tsenñu Jesús ya' disipululanu ma kaa baaku yachi sekuwangue' keenanu uudenguemi, pure' jiimu chachilla yanu menaa tyuli'ba kichudee tyatu,
matyu Jesús, dilu purenamulanu ura' demandireñu' mitya, naaju dilula bain yanu tene ta'kanu dekeena', menaatyuinu kiidekiñu' mitya.
Tsenñu chachillanu pumu Dioschi urajtu kuraa tiremu bu'chullala Jesúsnu katamiya tsaa ya' ajuusha teledi' watitu entsa entsandila: ¡Ñuya Diosa' Nave! tiitila.
Tsa tsa detiñu Jesús ya mu ju' tyee kiike' bain kumuinchi demeenaya tsandityudei ti' nepa nepatimi.
Jesús 12 ruku mi'ke' kami.
Tsangue' dyatu Jesús bene kuyisha lumi, tsejtu naaju chachillanaa yachi uraa tya'ba, juntsalanu demikami, tsejtu junga

wa'namu chachillanu 12 unbere mi'ke' katu, juntsa rukulanu entsangue mumu pumi: Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu rukula mumu pumi, tsenmalaa naa-uwanuba yaba bulu dene', naa Diosa' kuinda bain demijakares nesa tyatu.
Tsejtu juntsalanu naa dyabululanu bain deme-e'laanuu tiremi.
Entsalaa juntsa 12 ruku mi'ke' kayamula deeve: mainya Simón, tsaanuren Jesúsya Pedro mumu manbumi,
Zebedeo' nalaya: Santiago bain, Juan bain, entsalanuya Boanerges mumu manbumi, kuidya juuñuu rukula titu,
tsenmin Andrés bain, Felipe bain, Bartolomé bain, Mateo bain, Tomás bain, naa Alfeo' na Santiago bain, Tadeo bain, naa Simón, Diosa' lei naajuñuba tsa deki'ñu selandyamu tinu ruku bain,
tsenmin Jesúsnu kundaalanu wandi' kakaamu ruku Judas Iscariote bain.
Jesúsnu, dyabulu uñeetsanguikaantsuve, tila.
Tsejtu bene Jesús yasha miiñu, chachilla manen pure' wakudedi' yanu bain, naa ya' disipululanu bain panda fikaanu kityu jujuula.
Tsenñu Jesús' paandela mija' dejitu, naa Jesús merendyuba deranchi manga' mijiinuu jiila, matyu Jesús yujtaa ma iiñuve, tiititu.
Tsenmala Jerusalénsha pu' jimu leichi mashturula bain entsandintsula: Entsa rukunu dyabulu uñi Beelzebú tsanguikaañaa dyabulu me-e'laalaakive, tiitila.
Tsenñu Jesús yalanu mikatu entsangue laapu' kuinda kemi: Naake' Satanás maalin majuka'laanu juu jutyuve.
Tsaju' naa ma reichi uuden juu chumu chachilla bain yai tene kundaa detiya' velaa ne chudenashu juntsaa tsanan dejutyuve.
Tsenmin naa ma rukunu laapu' pañu bain, naa ya' shinbu bain, naa ya' kailla bain, tsaa yaitala kundaa devi' veladeishu juntsaa, naana chunuu juñuba tsa denatyu' tsaa de-iinu detsuve.
Tsa' mitya naa Satanás bain maalin kundaa tiya' tsaa develaishu juntsaa, tsanatyu' de-i' piyainu tsuve.
Tsenmin kayu Dyabulunu laapu' patu tsandimi: Dee ruku' chunu yanuya muba vi' yachi tiba taanguenuu dejutyuve, juntsa rukunu ajke' tele' tsuutyumujchiya; tsanguitaa tiba taanguenuu dejuve, timi.
Uwaindiyu Diosya munuba yala' ujcha' mitya bain, naa kentsure' padetiñu bain juntsa ujcha' mityaya demanbitsaanu juve;
tsaaren Espíritu Santonu kentsure' pamunuya naa-uwanuba juntsa ujcha manbitsalan jutyuu juve, tsaju' naa-uwanuba kuipa junu tsuve, timi.
Jesús entsandimiya yanu leichi mashturula Dioschi urajtu kuraa tiremu bu'chulla puuve detiñu' mityaa, tsandimi.
Jesúschi ura ya' bulula
Jesús tsandin punu uwanu ya' ama bain, ya' naatalala bain jila, tsejturen ya juushaa vityu' avindala ne uinala Jesúsnu lasa tya' veelanu mikakaakitu.
Tsenñu Jesús' keetala chumu chachilla tsandila: Ñu' ama bain, ñu' naatalala bain deja' avindala depu' ñunu mi'kes nendetsuve, tila.
Tsa detiñu Jesús entsandi pakami: ¿Maa in aman, tsenmin naajulaa in naatalala den? timi.
Tsanditu ya' keetala chumulanaa kere' patu tsandimi: Entsalaa in ama bain, in naatalala bain jumula deeve.
Matyu naajulaa Dios naakesa tyañuba tsanguen dechu'ba juntsalaa in naatalala bain, in ama bain dejuve, timi.
